behaviors.description: slugify.slugify converts text into a slug; with defaults, slugify('This is a test ---') returns the string 'this-is-a-test'.
The lowercase option defaults to True; setting lowercase=False preserves case, so slugify('This is a Test', lowercase=False) returns 'This-is-a-Test'.
The separator option sets the separator between words; slugify('one two three', separator='.') returns 'one.two.three'.
With max_length=12, word_boundary=True and save_order=True, slugify('one two three four') returns 'one-two', retaining whole words in their initial order.
